# AkkermanStroy

> AkkermanStroy is a German construction and renovation trade business (Handwerksbetrieb) based in Neubrandenburg, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, carrying out bathroom renovation, flooring, drywall, window and door fitting, and full renovations across Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin.

## Leistungen / Services

- [Badrenovierung / Bathroom renovation](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/badrenovierung.html): Full bathroom renovation from one contractor — strip-out, rough plumbing, composite waterproofing, tiling, barrier-free shower and sanitary fitting. Typical duration for a 6–8 m² bathroom: two to three weeks.
- [Bodenverlegung / Flooring](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/bodenarbeiten.html): Laminate, parquet, vinyl and designer flooring including substrate assessment, levelling and clean edge detailing.
- [Trockenbau & Innenausbau / Drywall and interior fit-out](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/innenausbau.html): Stud walls, suspended ceilings and skim finishing to quality levels Q1 to Q4, plus airless coating.
- [Fenster & Türen / Windows and doors](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/fenster-tueren.html): Roof window installation, interior doors and frames with correct fitting and clean junctions.
- [Komplettsanierung / Full renovation](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/komplettsanierung.html): Whole-property renovation with all trades coordinated by one contact — planning, strip-out, execution, handover.

## Einsatzgebiete / Service areas

- [Neubrandenburg](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/neubrandenburg.html): Home base. Phillip-Müller-Straße 4, 17033 Neubrandenburg. Strong focus on Plattenbau bathroom and floor renovation in Datzeberg, Oststadt and Reitbahnviertel.
- [Berlin](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/berlin.html): Gründerzeit Altbau renovation — timber joist floors, uneven substrates — plus listed-building and Milieuschutz (conservation area) permission constraints.
- [Rostock](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/rostock.html): Plattenbau renovation in Lütten Klein, Evershagen, Schmarl and Toitenwinkel; coastal humidity makes waterproofing and ventilation critical.
- [Schwerin](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/schwerin.html): Gründerzeit Altstadt and Schelfstadt work under heritage constraints, plus standardised Plattenbau at Großer Dreesch.
- [Stralsund](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/stralsund.html): UNESCO World Heritage old town — heritage approval required for anything externally visible; standard Plattenbau work in Knieper West and Grünhufe.

## Rechtliches / Legal

- [Impressum](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/impressum.html): Legal disclosure under § 5 DDG — owner, address, chamber of trades registration, VAT ID.
- [Datenschutzerklärung](https://www.akkerman-stroy.de/datenschutzerklaerung.html): GDPR/DSGVO privacy policy.

- Customers can deduct 20% of labour costs from German income tax, up to €1,200/year (§ 35a Abs. 3 EStG) — invoice must separate the labour share and be paid by bank transfer
